purpose: Authoring and handoff inventory. The portal renders current CMS Image fields; it does not import this file at runtime.
ownership: Public links and opaque DAM IDs refer to Media assets in the handed-over sandbox. Reusing this manifest in another tenant requires deliberate asset ownership/public-link setup and fresh native image field values.
seedBehavior: ContentCreateOnly seeds the original sample articles. ResourcePageBranch supplies local Data/Resource image for newly created pages. The twelve existing sample-article images were added as a separate native content operation; this inventory does not silently replace or reseed authored pages.
